name: Policy Lab
pitch_50: Reproducible evidence-to-decision research software that keeps provenance, assurance, explicit policy, bounded decisions, and resulting receipts inspectable.
description: Policy Lab studies what decision is supportable when identified evidence, its provenance and assurance state, and an explicit policy are evaluated together. Energy remains the demonstrated reference domain; broader generality is not assumed.
limitations: Research workbench only. No independent reproduction, source-holder or operator validation, institutional workflow, legal issuance authority, enforceable redemption, market adoption, paid use, monetary performance, calibrated policy thresholds, DPG recognition, JOSS acceptance, or general external validity is claimed.
